docs: SPORIM on devnet: the `Bet` format only — symmetric stakes, mutual decision, timeout
settlement, and a way out of every state (a disagreement refunds both; an abandoned bet
refunds to anyone who asks). No referee, no `Commit`/beneficiary payout yet; see
`constants.rs` and `docs/DECISIONS.md` for what that increment adds and why this one stops
short of it on purpose.

types.name: Bet
docs: The on-chain half of `packages/domain`'s `Bet`. Fixed-size and `Vec`/`String`-free like the
design in `docs/09-phase0-plan.md` §2.5 calls for — rent is deterministic and known before the
account is ever created.
`opponent` starts `None`: like the database's `accept-by-link` capability, whoever calls
`accept_bet` first (and is not the creator) takes the seat. There is no pinned-opponent path
in this increment — every bet is "anyone with the link".

fields.name: claim_outcome
docs: Set by `submit_claim`, read by `confirm_claim` and `settle_uncontested`. `None` before a
claim exists — there is no sentinel outcome value standing in for "nobody has claimed".

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the rent for this account and its vault at `create_bet` — the server's keypair, so
a person needs USDC and never SOL — and receives it back when the bet closes.

types.name: BetState
docs: Mirrors `packages/domain/src/types/bet.ts` `BetState`, minus `draft` (a bet never touches the
chain until it is shared) and `disputed` (no referee in this increment — see `constants.rs`).

types.name: Outcome
docs: Mirrors `packages/domain/src/types/bet.ts` `Outcome`. `Draw` is reachable here even without a
referee: the two parties can agree the terms tied, exactly like `calculateSettlement`'s
`outcome === 'draw'` branch — a referee is only needed when they *disagree*, which this
increment does not yet resolve on-chain.
